name: soladb-blob-v1
description: Merkle vectors of docs/blob-protocol.md §2. Hex strings. leafHash = sha256(0x00 ‖ 1024-byte segment), nodeHash = sha256(0x01 ‖ l ‖ r), trees padded with EMPTY (32 zero bytes) to a power of two at the input level. Proofs list siblings bottom-up. In each blob, shards 0..k-1 are arbitrary data and shards k..n-1 are their Reed-Solomon parity (GF(2^8)/0x11D, Cauchy C[i][j] = inv((k+i) xor j)), fragment by fragment. fragments[].proof goes from the fragment root (node `stripe` at height log2(F/1024)) to the shard root; segments[].proof is the prove_shard shard_proof; topProofs[j] is the prove_shard top_proof of shard j. challenge.segment = u64_le(sha256(slotHash ‖ blob ‖ [shardIndex])[0..8]) mod (shardSize / 1024), on blobs[1].
